reconstructed.flag_explanation: All 11 flagged windows are pre-existing in the Asian elephant reference genome before any reconstruction. TRPA1 flags are attributed to ankyrin repeat domains conserved between bacteria and eukaryotes. FASN flags correspond to high-GC windows (GC=0.637) resembling bacterial CDS composition. Neither MLM nor DAM reconstruction introduced novel virulence-gene signatures.

training.positive_source: 20 pathogen virulence sequences (E.coli stx1/stx2, S.aureus mecA/spa, Listeria hlyA, Salmonella sipA/invA, V.cholerae ctxA/ctxB, P.aeruginosa exoS/exoU)
